title: THE OBSERVATORY
notes: Painted scenery (revision 3, step D): the 5 st7 paintings (work/bg/gen/st7 -> strips tools/art/strips/st7, prompts tools/art/bg-prompts.json; st7 has no a0-2). a0 is the cliff road (one painting, 1312 px); a1 and a2 are the four strips of their two paintings in storyline order (a<N>-1 A, B, a<N>-2 A, B), overlapping 32 px with a floor-only crossfade (2592 px).

Gameplay structure (sections, lock counts, task props, casts, boss lock) from step B, re-fitted to the painted areas and their floor lines. The research archive is painted in a1 (a1-2), so 7-4 moved into a1 after the relay station (7-2) and the generator room (7-3); a2 holds the workshop and walker bay (7-5) and the control gallery (7-6, the boss arena at its far end).
